quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for electronic ad audio pulsing through a wet, reflective urban night environment.
quests.explanation: Pulsing holographic ad audio on wet night streets identifies a cyber city.
quests.textToSpeak: Holographic neon advertisements shift and pulse on the rain-dark cyber-city streets.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the sound of a brook as the dominant feature in an otherwise silent woodland.
quests.explanation: A brook as the dominant sound in a silent forest identifies a dense forest trail.
quests.textToSpeak: A babbling brook runs over mossy stones while the forest holds its breath around it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the electronic noise of radiation sensors responding to deep-space particle flux.
quests.explanation: Radiation sensor noise from cosmic particle flux identifies a spacecraft in deep space.
quests.textToSpeak: The cosmic radiation shimmer on the viewport glass gives space its eerie visual signature.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for simultaneous bubbling liquids and a high-speed spinning machine in a clean room.
quests.explanation: Bubbling reagents and centrifuge spin together identify a chemistry laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: Glass beakers bubble with reacting chemicals as the centrifuge spins in the clean room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the systematic opening of heavy gates and the convoy rumble of military vehicles.
quests.explanation: A controlled convoy entry through heavy gates identifies a military installation.
quests.textToSpeak: A supply convoy passes through the heavy gates as guards clear the route.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for clicking shell sounds in a dark environment lit only by a focused beam.
quests.explanation: Shell clicking in focused-beam darkness identifies the deep ocean floor.
quests.textToSpeak: Crustacean shells click rhythmically on the rocks far below the surface light.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a faint periodic motor sound from an overhead rotating surveillance device.
quests.explanation: An overhead rotating surveillance camera motor identifies a secured vault space.
quests.textToSpeak: The security camera turns slowly on its mount, its quiet motor marking the surveillance cycle.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for mechanical joint sounds transmitted through a spacecraft hull from outside.
quests.explanation: Exterior robotic arm joint sounds through the hull identify an orbital station.
quests.textToSpeak: A robotic maintenance arm moves outside, its joints audible through the hull.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the faint crackle of incense burning and deep ritual silence around it.
quests.explanation: Burning incense crackle in deep ritual silence identifies an ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: White incense threads rise toward the sky from the offering table in the courtyard.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for muffled jet engine sounds heard through thick airport glass.
quests.explanation: Muffled jet sounds through terminal glass with aircraft in view identifies an airport.
quests.textToSpeak: Large windows reveal a close-up view of aircraft tail fins and swept wings.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the brief but powerful wind blast of a high-speed train not stopping.
quests.explanation: Wind blast from a non-stopping express identifies a train station platform.
quests.textToSpeak: A passing intercity express creates a wall of wind that scatters platform rubbish.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the very careful, near-silent handling of fragile historical documents.
quests.explanation: Cotton-gloved document handling in careful silence identifies a library archive room.
quests.textToSpeak: Researchers handle rare volumes with cotton-gloved hands in the document archive.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the ticking deceleration of a prize wheel followed by crowd applause.
quests.explanation: A decelerating prize wheel and applause identify a shopping mall promotional event.
quests.textToSpeak: The prize wheel's pointer ticks on the pegs before landing to a burst of applause.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for warm social laughter crossing a muted, elegant dining environment.
quests.explanation: Warm party laughter in an elegant restaurant identifies a luxury dining experience.
quests.textToSpeak: Laughter from a celebratory party drifts across the quiet tables of the restaurant.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the collective silence of park visitors watching a bird in a tree.
quests.explanation: Collective visitor silence watching a bird in a tree identifies a city park.
quests.textToSpeak: A rare species of bird causes the entire park population to hold its breath.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a digital guidance voice describing a large indoor medical building layout.
quests.explanation: A digital guidance voice mapping a medical complex identifies a modern hospital.
quests.textToSpeak: A digital hospital map talks a visitor through the labyrinth of the medical complex.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for unexpected cheering from workers on a construction site.
quests.explanation: Workers cheering at a milestone ahead of schedule identifies a construction site.
quests.textToSpeak: Cheering breaks out as the roof structure is completed ahead of schedule.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for farm activity stopping as multiple people call others to look at the sky.
quests.explanation: Farm workers stopping to look at a rare bird in the sky identifies a lush farm.
quests.textToSpeak: A rare bird circles over the farm, drawing all hands out of the fields to watch.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the high signal tone of a metal detector finding something under a sandy surface.
quests.explanation: A metal detector strong-signal tone on a sandy surface identifies a beach.
quests.textToSpeak: The treasure hunter freezes as the detector registers a strong signal under the sand.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a climbing team falling silent as they watch an animal's precise movement.
quests.explanation: Climbers silently watching a mountain goat identifies a mountain peak.
quests.textToSpeak: The entire climbing team goes still as the lone mountain goat tests the rock above.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the dry whisper of leaves moving across old exposed tree roots at dusk.
quests.explanation: Leaves dancing across maple roots at dusk identifies a dense temperate forest.
quests.textToSpeak: Autumn leaves dance across the roots of old maples as the evening wind quickens.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the layered, bouncing echo of city electronics in a rain-wet environment.
quests.explanation: City electronics bouncing off wet surfaces identifies a cyber city at night.
quests.textToSpeak: The eternal neon night of the city reflects itself in every wet surface below.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for instruments registering a gravitational anomaly warping surrounding space.
quests.explanation: Instrument registration of gravitational light-bending identifies a spacecraft near a black hole.
quests.textToSpeak: A black hole bends the light of distant stars into a swirling gravitational arc.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the rising voltage hum of a particle accelerator reaching operational levels.
quests.explanation: Rising voltage hum reaching test levels identifies a physics research laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: Ozone clings in the air near the particle accelerator charging to test levels.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the sharp echo of boot heels on a perfectly maintained polished floor.
quests.explanation: Sharp boot heel echo on polished linoleum in a pristine building identifies a military HQ.
quests.textToSpeak: The waxed linoleum of the HQ corridor reflects the precision of its military occupants.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the near-silence of the deep ocean broken by the engine hum and drifting particles.
quests.explanation: Drifting marine snow in a submersible light cone identifies the deep ocean.
quests.textToSpeak: Organic marine snow drifts endlessly through the submersible light cone below.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the heightened acoustic sensitivity of a space that has been sealed for years.
quests.explanation: Heightened acoustics of a long-sealed space identify an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: The vault has not been disturbed for decades; every sound seems louder than it should.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for station life-support hum as the only sound in a completely star-filled silence.
quests.explanation: Station life-support hum in starlight silence identifies an orbital station.
quests.textToSpeak: Silence and starlight greet the astronaut at the observation window of the station.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the crackle of flame and a sacred silence deeper than most places allow.
quests.explanation: Sacred flame crackle and absolute midnight silence identify an ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: The midnight temple holds its breath between prayers, flame and silence its only inhabitants.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the unique emotional ambient soundscape of a place where journeys begin and end.
quests.explanation: The emotional ambient hum of a transit hub identifies a busy international airport.
quests.textToSpeak: Every corner of the terminal holds someone at the start or end of a journey.
